id.description: Stable pack identifier, immutable across versions of the same pack (e.g. 'opmed-cds-docs').

version.description: Semver 2.0.0. Precedence per semver.org sec 11 (numeric MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, then pre-release comparison).

published_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp, UTC recommended (e.g. 2026-09-05T00:00:00Z). Drives recency ranking (C4) and MUST NOT be confused with the pack file's mtime.

supersedes.description: List of 'id@version' strings this pack version explicitly supersedes. Upgrade policy (own-id vs cross-id) is PackManager-level (C2/C3) and recorded in docs/adr/0004-knowledge-packs.md.

model_id.description: e.g. 'snowflake-arctic-embed-m-v1.5' or 'bge-small-en-v1.5'; must match the id ADR-0001 (A5) freezes.

normalize.description: Whether stored vectors are L2-normalized; consumers must match at query time or re-embed.

path.description: Relative path within the pack, forward-slash separated, no '..' segments (enforced by validator + C8 hardening).

sha256.description: Content hash of the raw doc file BEFORE chunking; this is the doc identity used in chunk id derivation, not a path hash.

path.description: Relative path to a prebuilt index.sqlite (packtool output, see C6).

schema_version.description: Must match contracts/store.schema.sql SCHEMA_VERSION (B5) or the pack is refused (C8).

signature.description: Optional detached signature block, format finalized by C8.
